title: Id And Uri System
description: Implement primary ID system and secondary URI system for repo. IDs use emoji prefixes with paths. URIs use semiorepo:// scheme. Extend MCP resources, VS Code extension navigation, and add a general navigate command. Extend existing tests.
summary: Implemented dual ID/URI system: refactored GetArtifactID/GetArtifactURI with collection types, added IdToUri/UriToId bidirectional conversion, updated MCP resource templates/handlers, added navigate MCP tool, added semio.navigate VS Code command, extended Go and VS Code tests, updated AGENTS.md and README.md
